title: Integrating Tessl with Cursor
description:
Ready to supercharge your AI coding agent? This quick tutorial shows you how to seamlessly integrate Tessl with Cursor. 

Once you've initialized a Tessl project, connecting your favorite agent is just one command away. Watch as we run the "tessl setup agent" command and let our CLI automatically configure the MCP integration for you. In seconds, Cursor will pick up the Tessl MCP server, and you'll be ready to go! 

With Tessl and Cursor connected, you're all set to leverage the power of the Spec Registry and the Tessl framework in your Spec Driven Development workflow.
